# Free Exercise DB

Exercise demonstration images are sourced from [yuhonas/free-exercise-db](https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db) at commit `f00c92c7dcf1216a928a52c3706c7ce8e2f71ed5`.

The upstream repository releases the dataset into the public domain under the Unlicense. Its `LICENSE.md` contents are preserved verbatim in `free-exercise-db-UNLICENSE`.

Only manually reviewed exercise matches are included in the production manifest. The selected files are served from the Coach Fit Pro Cloudflare R2 domain; the upstream checkout is not bundled into the application.
